messages:
Maria Chen: quick async standup for gw/routing/auth/rate-limits

Maria Chen: yesterday: finished the routing-policy matcher refactor and added unit tests for path-prefix + header combos. Pushed branch `gw/routing-refactor` and opened PR.
Maria Chen: blocker: need clarification on preflight order for header-based rules — some legacy clients send x-client-env and we need to decide precedence.
Maria Chen: today: will address review comments, add integration test against envoy-config simulation, and start smoke canary if CI green.

Alex Rivera: noted on the PR, left comments about the matcher complexity. I can pair on the precedence logic later today.
Alex Rivera: FYI rate-limits work: I saw a spike on staging causing 429s around 03:10 UTC — looks like a misapplied burst window on the tenant policy.

Jin Park: blocker for me: auth middleware change in #3456 (token introspection TTL) made the redis cache key namespace different, causing some token misses and 401s in nightly tests. I have a short patch but want to run it through staging.
Jin Park: today I'll coordinate with infra to clear stale keys and deploy the patch behind a feature flag.

Sam O'Neill: I can do the canary rollout once Maria's PR is merged. Can we schedule the canary for 15:30 PT? I'm free then. :+1:
Sam O'Neill: Also, Alex — can you drop the stacktrace from the 429? Helps to confirm whether it's burst-window vs token bucket leak.

Alex Rivera: pasted small log snippet: ```
[2026-06-12T03:10:12Z] tenant=acme service=gw rate_limit=429 rule=tenant_global burst=500 window=60 tokens=0
```

Maria Chen: thanks Alex — that suggests burst was exhausted. I think our simulation had a lower steady-state QPS. I'll add a regression test to simulate sustained 600rps for 30s.

Jin Park: patch for auth cache: `redis_key = f"auth:token:{tenant_id}:{sha(token)}"` — will run in staging behind flag `auth.cache.v2`. If anyone sees unexpected 401s after 03:45 PT please ping me.

Sam O'Neill: deploy-bot scheduled canary: deploy-bot: Canary started for sha=abc123 to gw-prod-canary at 15:31 PT. Monitoring: latency, 429s, auth-errors.

deploy-bot: Canary health: all checks green for first 5 minutes. Observability link: https://console.redwood/gw/canaries/abc123

Maria Chen: action items captured: 1) I will add precedence doc and integration tests. 2) Jin will deploy auth patch behind flag and monitor. 3) Alex to help debug rate-limit spike test. 4) Sam to run canary at 15:30 PT.

Alex Rivera: ping for code review: @Maria Chen — small nit in matcher regex. I'll re-review after you update precedence doc.

Maria Chen: thanks all — updating PR now. If folks want to sync live, I'm available at 15:00 PT in #eng-platform-call.

Sam O'Neill: thumbs up :thumbsup:

Jin Park: noted, pushing the patch to staging now. Will update thread when done.

Maria Chen: last: small policy snippet I added for header-first precedence:```
- name: header-first-route
  match:
    headers:
      - name: x-client-env
        exact: "edge"
  action: route_to_edge
```

Maria Chen: end of thread.
